articles.title: For $415k, you can live in a New England community library
articles.description:
Built in 1850, it originally served as the Vestry Schoolhouse for the small farming community of Foster, R.I., before becoming the Tyler Free Library in 1953.

The post For $415k, you can live in a New England community library appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Tyler Free Library in Foster, RI, is listed for $415,000 as a residential property.
Originally built in 1850, it served as a schoolhouse before becoming a library in 1953.
Boston residents can explore unique housing options in nearby Rhode Island communities.
